Hi Priya / Tom — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- What we heard: Novacare wants to validate latency and controls for user PII redaction, and confirm procurement/budget timing for Q4.
- Next milestone: 60-min technical demo (hands-on, infra and SSO walkthrough) + 30-min compliance session with your security owner.

Proposed demo windows (PT):
- Option A: Wed, Sep 8 — 10:00–11:00am PT
- Option B: Thu, Sep 9 — 2:00–3:00pm PT

Can you confirm which works, and whether we should split into two meetings (tech + compliance) or do a single extended session? Also looped in Marissa (technical lead) and Karthik (procurement lead) — they can present relevant artifacts.

Attaching the short post-call notes and a draft agenda. (attachment: post-call-notes.pdf)

If helpful, feel free to reply with a calendar invite or your preferred slot and the email for your security contact — I’ll send the calendar hold.

Thanks —
